Acalvio Technologies provides Deception as a Service (DaaS) through its ShadowPlex platform. 
Acalvio ShadowPlex is an Autonomous Deception Platform deployed as Software as a Service (SaaS) on the Amazon - AWS US East/West Platform as a Service (PaaS) and offers the following core services to enterprises:
•        Threat Detection
•        Investigation
•        Response capabilities
These three core features are seamlessly integrated into the foundational ShadowPlex services.
